description: Paste X post links, post IDs or profile handles. Choose whether to include replies, quote posts and author details.

includeAuthorProfile.description: Attach the author's public profile details (followers, bio, verification) to every post, reply and quote row under author and authorProfile.
includeAuthorProfile.title: Include author profile details

includeMedia.description: Include image links, video links and video variants for each post.
includeMedia.title: Include images and videos

includeParentTweet.description: When a collected post is a reply, attach the post it answers under parentTweet.
includeParentTweet.title: Include the post being replied to

includeQuotedTweet.description: When a collected post quotes another post, attach the quoted post's text, author and metrics.
includeQuotedTweet.title: Include the post each result quotes

includeQuotes.description: Collect the posts that quote each requested post, with their text, author and engagement counts.
includeQuotes.title: Include quote posts

includeReplies.description: Collect the replies X shows for each post, walked forward from the post's publication time.
includeReplies.title: Include replies

includeRetweeters.description: Collect the handles of accounts that reposted each requested post. X only exposes a search-index sample of visible reposts, so this is an approximate, recent-biased list.
includeRetweeters.title: Include retweeter handles

includeThreadAncestors.description: When a requested post is a reply, walk up to 10 posts back to the start of the thread and attach them under threadAncestors (root first).
includeThreadAncestors.title: Include the full thread above a reply

maxQuotes.description: How many quote posts to collect for each requested post (0-500).
maxQuotes.title: Maximum quote posts per post

maxReplies.description: How many replies to collect for each post (0-500). Posts with very large threads may return fewer because X does not expose every reply to logged-out visitors.
maxReplies.title: Maximum replies per post

maxRetweeters.description: How many retweeter handles to collect for each post (0-500).
maxRetweeters.title: Maximum retweeters per post

tweetUrls.description: Paste the posts you want to collect. You can also paste post IDs, x.com/i/web/status links, twitter.com links, profile links or bare handles (a profile input returns that profile's public details).
tweetUrls.title: Post links, post IDs or profile handles

title: X Post, Reply & Profile Lookup input
